pages.text: $(bold)Bendable, Not Breakable$()$(br)The tier system can be bent by skilled players, not broken. One next-tier item early = feature. Skipping a tier = bug.$(br2)$(bold)Abundance, Not Scarcity$()$(br)No resource locks. Crops, building, QoL, and travel are day one. Only $(italic)power$() is gated — weapons, armor, magic, dimensions.$(br2)$(bold)Death Is a Cost$()$(br)Keep inventory is on. Gear loses durability on death; at zero, items go $(italic)inert$(). Dying in $(t1)T1$() is cheap. Dying with $(t4)T4$() gear is expensive.$(br2)$(bold)Boss Fights Are the Pinnacle$()$(br)Best weapons (Simply Swords uniques) drop only from bosses. Cannot be crafted or traded.
